title: The Line
draft: Built 2026-10-18 from the 4.3 'Base Chain' stub's B3 with its defaults ('take the defaults and build 4.3c'): the Cubbon bandstand on the army's lamp line next to the Vidhana Soudha camp (a lit island; the camp itself is told, not drawn), Ananya by relationship (there unless strained — otherwise the photo she left), Major Rathore's supply runs 1–4 (medicines at Hebbal General, a radio at Majestic — the stub's telecom tower moved to the depot, battery cores at Church Street's 'Reliable Digital', emitter parts at HIVR) with Priya, the argument at the fire (Karthik evacuate / Priya fight / Suresh hold), and the line cut on the fourth night → the Palace (B4, run 5 and the Pulse Gun, next phase).
time: Act 4 day 7 07:00 → the morning of day 11
player_goal: Hold the army's lamp line at Cubbon, and bring Rathore what his engineer needs.
design_goal: The camp is the first place in Act 4 with structure: an officer, a list, a gate. Each run returns to somewhere the player has been (the hospital gate of 4.0, the interchange of 2.2, Church Street of 2.4, the corridor of 3.3 — walked as yourself this time) and each returns with one thing. The argument plants the ending axis.

cast.role: NEW. Major Rathore (a fictional officer, no insignia): the list of five things for the engineer's gun; the runs start at the camp gate.
NEW. Priya, payment-software engineer turned fighter (a taped cricket bat): walks point on the runs; the 'end it' voice.
With the camp, photographing for the record — unless 2.6 left you strained; then a photo on the noticeboard: 'Went with the first trucks.'
Here since day 3: the 'get out' voice.

beats.what: The walk (or Kumar's drive) from the dead café to Cubbon: purple lamps on poles; 'Welcome to the line.' The camp by the bandstand: a cot, a crate, a bench.
Major Rathore: the engineer's gun, five things; the first, medicines at Hebbal General. Priya: 'I want to take it to HIVR and end this.'
Run 1: Hebbal General — the 4.0 gate, two of them at the hospital doors; the slot shop's stockroom. Back at dusk; deliver.
Run 2, a quiet one: Majestic — the interchange, two still by the pillars; the depot kiosk's radio. An evening at the camp.
Run 3: Church Street — the busker's corner empty, his case open; two by the bookshop; the Reliable Digital counter.
Run 4: HIVR — the corridor you walked as Ravi, yourself this time; two at the far end; the steriliser's tube and driver board.
The fire, after the last run: Karthik (get out), Priya (end it), Suresh (hold) — and they look at you.
The fourth night the line is cut (a card); Rathore: the Palace grounds.

economy.note: the camp's stock is the same shelf

assets_needed: Rathore's and Priya's sheets (generated, first try)
acceptance: the bot plays it from the café to Rathore's decision
each run walks quietly past two still infected
the HIVR corridor plays as yourself in Act 4
